meta.title: Shito-ryu Black Belt Written Exam — Practice Test
meta.source: Katsu Dojo Digital Textbook (Third Edition), Part Six 'Written Examinations'
meta.page_mapping: Printed pages 115–129 = PDF pages 116–130 (printed = PDF − 1). Printed p. 130 does not exist; the PDF ends at printed 129. Printed 115 is the section title page (no testable content).
known_issues: Green/Brown test (p. 126) numbering jumps from 11 to 14; questions 12–13 absent from the page.
Jion meaning worded two ways (p. 127 vs p. 129); Heian meanings 'Peaceful Mind #n' vs '... Kata'.
Rouhai appears only in the p. 129 list, not as any belt's testing kata.
meta.grading: 100% to pass; spelling only has to be close.

questions.answer: Shiho No Kata: Four direction kata; Ten No Kata: Heavenly kata; Kihon No Kata: Basic kata; Chi No Kata: Earth kata; Heian Shodan: Peaceful mind #1 kata; Heian Nidan: Peaceful mind #2 kata; Heian Sandan: Peaceful mind #3 kata; Heian Yondan: Peaceful mind #4 kata; Heian Godan: Peaceful mind #5 kata; Jitte: Ten hands kata; Jin: Named after a spirit; Jion: Named after a temple in China; Jyuroku: Sixteen kata; Rouhai: Vision of a white heron

questions.prompt: Each kata below is named as the new (or second) testing kata on one belt's written test. Write the letter of that belt.
questions.answer: a-K Jin; b-G Heian Sandan; c-D Chi No Kata; d-M Jyuroku; e-A Shiho No Kata; f-I Heian Godan; g-C Kihon No Kata; h-L Jion; i-F Heian Nidan; j-B Ten No Kata; k-J Jitte; l-E Heian Shodan; m-H Heian Yondan
